## Triage: first touch → `domain:server` · `lease:A5` · p2 · 2026-11-16T05:45Z

⛔ Not a claim.

Measured on #33835: a hot `install-local` re-syncs the whole deployment twice (every object schema and every flow) instead of only what the package changed (its objects, the objects it extends, and the flows bound to them). Install time grows with the size of the whole deployment rather than the package. Performance, under epic #33631, so **p2**.
